authority: Merseytravel — Mersey Ferries (Liverpool City Region Combined Authority)
operator_note: Mersey Ferries operated by Merseytravel, the transport arm of the Liverpool City Region Combined Authority — a public transport authority. Stakeholder = Liverpool City Region CA / Merseytravel.
seed_node_coords_source: River Mersey channel between Pier Head (Liverpool) and Seacombe (Wallasey); mint on water. Retrieved 2026-07-02.
cluster_id: uk (confirm against existing UK cluster convention at seal time)
decarbonization_anchor: Liverpool City Region has committed to a zero-carbon target by 2035 and is pursuing zero-emission ferry renewal; Woodside landing stage is under major refurbishment as part of terminal upgrades. A fast, zero-emission foiling tier restores the cross-river commute the current 50-minute heritage service no longer serves well.
network_reality: Cross-Mersey service from Liverpool (Gerry Marsden / Pier Head) to Seacombe (Wallasey) and Woodside (Birkenhead). Woodside currently closed for landing-stage works; Seacombe and Pier Head active. Historic daily commuter link now largely a River Explorer cruise — the credible gap for a genuine fast commuter tier.
geometry_note: Short open-water crossings on the River Mersey estuary; hand-waypoint to keep clear of Pier Head / landing-stage shorelines; no land crossings.
atlas_warning: ALL existing atlas hits for these names are mis-geocoded junk (Birkenhead Point Marina -> Sydney AU; Woodside Ferry Terminal -> Nova Scotia; 'Liverpool marine ferry' -> Nigeria; Birkenhead -> New Zealand). Do NOT bind any of them. Greenfield mint only.
provenance: merseyferries.co.uk (Gerry Marsden/Pier Head + Seacombe active); merseytravel.gov.uk (Seacombe reopen, Woodside works); Wikivoyage Mersey Ferry (Liverpool/Seacombe/Woodside). Retrieved 2026-07-02.
